courseBuilder.rule: do not delete a generator, seed, media, import/export, validation, or partner integration until its behavior is represented by the canonical pipeline

devStudio.rule: admin is the operational Dev Studio; marketing/store routes may remain only as product/landing surfaces; LMS route must redirect or delegate unless it provides unique authenticated capability

orchestrator.rule: one supervisor; specialized workers may remain only when they expose unique capabilities through the supervisor registry

supabase.rule: one authoritative schema history; duplicate migrations must be reconciled, never blindly deleted after application

cloudflare.rule: one environment naming scheme and one documented deployment path; preserve existing bindings until consumers are migrated

github.rule: all future production development lands here after donor parity is verified

documentation.rule: README and architecture docs must describe only the final verified system, not historical or aspirational states

pluginsAndIntegrations.rule: existing working integrations are dependencies; consolidate wrappers and configuration around them without disconnecting providers

deletionGate: merge unique capabilities into canonical implementation
